newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Stantronic a step closer to listing.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Stantronic a step closer to listing.

text.p: South Africa's Stantronic Investments said on Tuesday all conditions precedent for its reverse-listing into the General Technologies (Gentech) had been met except approval by Gentech shareholders.
It said in a statement that approval would be sought from shareholders at a general meeting to be held on May 30.

The meeting will discuss, among others, the acquisition of Stantronic by Gentech for 84.5 million rand with effect from March 1 and the conditional offer to Gentech minorities of 13.9 cents in cash per Gentech share.
